findings.diagnosis: BIG, 'Improve account access', combines a three-day session-token verifier and an independent three-day account-recovery UI. The six-day ticket exceeds the 1-3 day target and ties together work that can ship independently, hiding progress and delaying separate delivery.
findings.recommended_action: Split BIG into two three-day tickets, one for the verifier and one for the recovery UI, each with its own deliverable.
